bio.text: Juan Alanis, a Republican, represents the 22nd Assembly District, which covers parts of Merced and Stanislaus counties, in the California State Assembly.
According to the Ceres Courier, Alanis was born in 1978 in Modesto, was raised in Riverbank, and was a Stanislaus County Sheriff's sergeant before his election to the Legislature in 2022.
The Ceres Courier reports he was re-elected in 2024.
